overview: The City Council opened its 2018 term by electing officers, adopting standing rules, and honoring retired School Committee member Lena DiGiandomaso. The council also approved initial Community Preservation Act revenue allocations, including $300,000 for phase one of the Harris Park rehabilitation project.

items.title: Election of City Messenger
items.summary: Elected Lawrence Lepore unanimously following a nomination by Councilor Fred Dello Russo.

items.title: Adoption of Rules and Carryover of 2017 Business
items.summary: Adopted the standing committee rules as council rules for 2018 and transferred all pending papers and tabled committee items from the 2017 council.

items.title: Resolution Honoring Lena DiGiandomaso
items.summary: Approved a resolution commending 30-year School Committee veteran Lena DiGiandomaso for her civic service and requesting that the school department dedicate a facility in her honor.

items.title: FY 2017 Community Preservation Act Revenue Allocation
items.summary: Approved the required reserve of 10 percent of FY 2017 Community Preservation Act revenues into each statutory program category with the balance allocated to general reserves.

items.title: CPA Appropriation for Harris Park Rehabilitation
items.summary: Approved an off-cycle appropriation of $300,000 in CPA funds to serve as matching funds for a federal Land and Water Conservation Fund grant to rehabilitate Harris Park.

items.title: Food Truck Permit for Television Production
items.summary: Approved an endorsement allowing a private catering food truck at the VFW parking lot for crew members filming the television series City on a Hill.

items.title: Sidewalk Repair at Bradshaw and Honeywell
items.summary: Referred a request to the Department of Public Works to repair a buckled sidewalk panel damaged by tree roots at the corner of Bradshaw and Honeywell.

items.title: Sidewalk Snow Removal Apparatus and Linkage Inquiry
items.summary: Approved a resolution supporting the acquisition of sidewalk snow-clearing equipment—with the administration reporting the pending purchase of a $130,545 Holder tractor—and requested an accounting of available development linkage funds.

items.title: Condolences and Memorial Dedications
items.summary: Extended council condolences to the families of Joseph Pace, John Bob Conner, and Dante DeFranco Sr., and dedicated the meeting to the memory of former Governor's Councilor Michael J. Callahan.

items.title: Annual Employee Diversity Training Estimate
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a cost estimate from the administration to institute mandatory annual diversity training for all city employees.

items.title: Directed Traffic Patrols on Hastings Lane
items.summary: Approved a request for directed police enforcement of commuter-hour resident-access restrictions on Hastings Lane, along with a companion measure asking police to contact navigation app Waze to correct cut-through routing.
